description: A live recording: the exports/ directory is the output of the runner export action for the appsec-review/graph-export-cpp pack (tree_sha256 93b9a8bf0e4b634035b49b4888344bd6abaf772615635b7452471e4ed8b77656, which filters CMake compiler-id sources under codeql-build/CMakeFiles) over the traced build of tests/fixtures/build_toolchains/native, captured from tests/live/test_codeql_graph_export_live.py with CodeQL 2.27.0 in WSL Docker using images built from this repository. bqrs_sha256 values are the real BQRS hashes. tests/live/test_codeql_graph_export_live.py compares a live export's columns, rows, row_count and truncated with these files and fails with a diff when they drift; refresh by copying a passing live run's exports/ here and regenerating the golden output. The native fixture has no sources or sinks, so the dataflow families are proven only by the synthetic fixtures.
